goal: Determinar que evidencia respalda el eje FTO-m6A-FOS en celulas de la granulosa humanas, y en que modelos y con que controles fue validado mas alla de Jiang et al. 2021.

questions.question: According to Jiang et al. (2021) and any related sources, what is the proposed mechanism by which the m6A demethylase FTO regulates FOS expression in human granulosa cells?
What experimental models (cell lines, primary cells, animal models) and molecular techniques were used to establish the FTO-m6A-FOS axis, according to these sources?

Beyond Jiang et al. (2021), what other sources in this corpus independently support, replicate, or extend evidence for a functional link between FTO, m6A methylation, and FOS (or related immediate-early genes) in granulosa or other reproductive cells?

What experimental controls (e.g., FTO knockdown/overexpression, catalytically dead FTO mutants, m6A site mutants) were used in these sources to demonstrate that FTO acts specifically through m6A demethylation on FOS transcripts, rather than through indirect or off-target effects?
How do these sources connect FTO/m6A dysregulation in granulosa cells to premature ovarian insufficiency or ovarian aging phenotypes?
What gaps, unresolved questions, or lack of independent replication remain in these sources regarding the FTO-m6A-FOS axis in human granulosa cells?
